QuestInfo.name: The Peerage
QuestInfo.0: The Empress calls. What could it be about?
QuestInfo.1:
The Empress wants to introduce your new allies. Head to Ereve.

#b(If there is a problem during the quest, you can forfeit it and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2:
You met your fellow Cygnus Knights.

There's #r#eOz#k#n, the Magician of Fire, #r#eIrena#k#n, the Bowman of the Winds, #r#eEckhart#k#n, the Thief of Darkness, and #r#eHawkeye#n#k, the Pirate of Lightning#n#k.

You'll serve with them on missions from now on.
